svg.aria-label: S4 Next PC: the mux and its priority
svg.text: S4 Next PC: the mux and its priority
Seven sources can supply the next fetch address. A later tier overrides an earlier one.
The next PC is PC + 8 instructions.
It answers at once, with no bubble.
The target comes from the L1I line.
Execute beats decode, and decode beats fetch.
The M1 does not have it.
The L1 BTB and direction predictor check L0.
Only a second miss replaces an entry.
After Calder and Grunwald, ISCA 1995, and Reinman, Austin and Calder, ISCA 1999.
Knowledge base: fetch.width, btb.l0_entries, btb.taken_bubble, ras.return_bubble, indpred.capacity, dirpred.mispredict_penalty, ftq.present, staged_fetch_redirect, nfp_training
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
